title: Design book and handoff entry
guidance: Consolidate human guidance by searchable component/page name, visible wording, aliases and source. Do not retain annotation numbers.
The existing record owns decisions, parameters, source links and component/parent/page evidence. Keep human feedback, image inspection, automated checks and final human judgment distinct.
Unvisited states remain explicit. Captured-only and superseded images must not look like current visual acceptance.

User prefers a simple efficient machine-searchable index/database over a delicate human-facing book. JSON records remain canonical; generate compact component/source/consumer lookup and enforce consistency/staleness checks. No new presentation polish required.

Implement the planned source-derived AST dependency/impact tooling now for the UX/UI HTML app, with strict canonical-component checks, alias/re-export/wrapper/transitive routes, CSS/token edges and explicit dynamic unknowns. Add actual CLI and generated impact reports rather than only maintaining textual/manual consumer lists.

decisions.title: Modular searchable records
decisions.reason: Names and aliases rank first; guidance, source and scenario metadata remain searchable without capture-payload noise. Record selection reveals and focuses its heading; the active marker survives search changes and URL fragments open the requested record.

decisions.title: Evidence with scope and provenance
decisions.reason: Filter current inspected, all current or historical evidence by theme and component/parent/page view. Captions show inspection scope and source fingerprints. Current token definitions come directly from theme JSON.

decisions.title: Portable entry and live links
decisions.reason: The library exposes a Design book action. The portable archive includes the same records and curated images; live-state links follow its actual server port while original capture URLs remain in provenance.

decisions.title: Scoped evidence revisions remain explicit
decisions.reason: A record defaults to its latest inspected evidence revision. Older captures remain visible with a no-new-inspection qualifier; history and captured-only support remain separately filterable.

decisions.title: Keyboard outlines remain complete in the bounded index
decisions.reason: Mobile search results have internal focus/scroll clearance. Compensating outer margins preserve their alignment with the search field. Actual Tab first/last retakes passed both themes and widths.

decisions.title: 1.8 machine-first lookup and consistency
decisions.reason: Canonical JSON records remain the small database. Generated INDEX.md/component-index.json expose selectors, aliases, owning source, scoped page consumers and shared API call sites including lab/palette utilities. Source/record hashes make stale lookups fail validation. Actual rendered consistency sweeps are separate from image judgment; no viewer polish is required.

decisions.title: Compiler-derived machine index and enforced boundary
decisions.reason: Resolved symbols, aliases/re-exports/wrappers, reverse routes and CSS/token edges feed the existing index. Strict checks reject stale scope and demonstrated duplicate/paint bypasses. Unknown dynamic usage remains explicit; JSON is sufficient without a new database service.

parameters.name: Book layout
parameters.description: Desktop uses an18rem sticky search/index beside the record; below55rem it stacks with a bounded scrollable index. Evidence filters and status cards stack on narrow screens.

parameters.name: Inherited appearance
parameters.description: No separate book palette; native links, controls and visible keyboard focus.

parameters.name: Evidence revision
parameters.description: evidenceRevision is selected from the numerically latest non-superseded inspected revision, not capture insertion order. Captions retain each original source identity.

parameters.name: Index focus clearance
parameters.description: At max-width55rem, .5rem internal/scroll padding and .5rem link scroll margin contain the external 3px outline with3px offset; -.5rem outer inline margins preserve alignment.

parameters.name: Evidence-revision validation
parameters.description: The validator requires the numerically latest non-superseded scoped inspected revision, guarding against a baseline capture inserted at the end of an array.
